entry_before.claim_zh: 活动后果可改变后继形成与选择条件，贡献变体不必获益。重构、发育与聚合区分遗传群体和运输集合；细菌回复实验接通遗传切换与周期完成。谱系预测保留总体优势及局部失败。新增原始实证支持呼吸形成氧梯度并改变后续选择；结构形成史须接入发育迁移，常规解释获完整信用。 原始延时研究进一步记录界面小筏形成、下落和再形成；酸碱条件改变空间组织，须与持续膜结构和实际后代分别对应。 此前比较方向提出独立机制约束下的跨条件接续，以及重构和选择关系自身的改变。 新的24小时形成实测与常规模型进一步接通建立条件和留存占比；较低离散的优势取决于相对生长，反例保留。 已完成的演化组织说明进一步接通实际取样、继承发育状态与跨转移重建；组织改变后续取样结果，真实供给及后续修订均保留。 原始显微数据现核对真实尺度及逐位置拍摄时钟，混合培养两段采集的位置配置可接续；成像对应与培养物身份仍分别论证。 直接同等网络比较现证明重构机制具有精确的常规实现，包含依当前状态选择及失败行动。 Ren现明确要求聚焦理论：复用形成、重构、更新器及目的修订成果，比较其独立前提与额外解释，下一连接是具体联结论学习结果的恢复。 预先固定视野的91帧现接成实测发育史；增长后的局部消失与轨迹的边界删失分别保留，观察结束不独自说明结构丧失。 新理论连接把后继重建能力接到完整回返路径的选择阈值及繁殖代价；直接外形延续可下降，第一代相同产出仍可掩盖相反的增长条件。
entry_before.claim_en: Consequences can change successor formation and selection without guaranteeing contributor advantage. Reconstruction, development and aggregation distinguish inherited clusters from transport groups; bacterial reversion links switching to cycle completion. Lineage forecasts retain aggregate gains and local failures. Primary evidence now links respiration-generated oxygen gradients to changed selection; structural development must enter transferable prediction. Conventional explanation receives full credit. Original time-lapse research adds recurring surface rafts and pH-sensitive spatial organization, requiring separate correspondences for persistent mat structure and actual descendants. Earlier comparative work proposed continuation across conditions constrained by independent mechanisms, followed by changes in reconstruction and selection relations. New 24-hour observations and a conventional model connect establishment to retained representation; lower dispersal gains only under the relative-growth condition, with an adverse contrast preserved. The completed evolutionary-organization account now connects actual sampling, inherited developmental state and reconstruction across transfers; formed organization changes later sampling, with actual provision and subsequent revision retained. Original microscopy now supplies checked scale and position-specific capture times, with continued position configuration across two rescue acquisitions; imaging correspondence and culture identity remain distinct. A direct matched-network comparison now establishes an exact conventional realization of the reconstruction mechanism, including shared state-dependent selectors and failed actions. Ren now directs a theoretical focus: reuse formation, reconstruction, updater and goal-revision results, compare their independent premises and added explanation, and recover a specific connectionist learning result. A predefined field now has a measured 91-frame developmental history; local disappearance after growth is distinguished from boundary censoring, so an observation ending does not alone establish structural loss. A new theoretical connection gives a full-cycle selection threshold and reproductive cost ceiling for inherited reconstruction; direct resemblance can fall, and identical first-generation outputs can conceal opposite growth conditions.

entry_after.title_zh: 生成对选择的递归影响
entry_after.title_en: Recursive influence of generation on selection
entry_after.claim_zh: 活动后果可改变后继形成与选择条件，贡献变体不必获益。重构、发育与聚合区分遗传群体和运输集合；细菌回复实验接通遗传切换与周期完成。谱系预测保留总体优势及局部失败。新增原始实证支持呼吸形成氧梯度并改变后续选择；结构形成史须接入发育迁移，常规解释获完整信用。 原始延时研究进一步记录界面小筏形成、下落和再形成；酸碱条件改变空间组织，须与持续膜结构和实际后代分别对应。 此前比较方向提出独立机制约束下的跨条件接续，以及重构和选择关系自身的改变。 新的24小时形成实测与常规模型进一步接通建立条件和留存占比；较低离散的优势取决于相对生长，反例保留。 已完成的演化组织说明进一步接通实际取样、继承发育状态与跨转移重建；组织改变后续取样结果，真实供给及后续修订均保留。 原始显微数据现核对真实尺度及逐位置拍摄时钟，混合培养两段采集的位置配置可接续；成像对应与培养物身份仍分别论证。 直接同等网络比较现证明重构机制具有精确的常规实现，包含依当前状态选择及失败行动。 Ren现明确要求聚焦理论：复用形成、重构、更新器及目的修订成果，比较其独立前提与额外解释，当时选定具体联结论学习结果的恢复。 预先固定视野的91帧现接成实测发育史；增长后的局部消失与轨迹的边界删失分别保留，观察结束不独自说明结构丧失。 新理论连接把后继重建能力接到完整回返路径的选择阈值及繁殖代价；直接外形延续可下降，第一代相同产出仍可掩盖相反的增长条件。 现已恢复单步Hebb方向，有限循环发育的后果响应由规律导出；tanh符号相容条件保持方向，并支持有限关系改变，反馈和选择关系改变可反转局部增益。
entry_after.claim_en: Consequences can change successor formation and selection without guaranteeing contributor advantage. Reconstruction, development and aggregation distinguish inherited clusters from transport groups; bacterial reversion links switching to cycle completion. Lineage forecasts retain aggregate gains and local failures. Primary evidence now links respiration-generated oxygen gradients to changed selection; structural development must enter transferable prediction. Conventional explanation receives full credit. Original time-lapse research adds recurring surface rafts and pH-sensitive spatial organization, requiring separate correspondences for persistent mat structure and actual descendants. Earlier comparative work proposed continuation across conditions constrained by independent mechanisms, followed by changes in reconstruction and selection relations. New 24-hour observations and a conventional model connect establishment to retained representation; lower dispersal gains only under the relative-growth condition, with an adverse contrast preserved. The completed evolutionary-organization account now connects actual sampling, inherited developmental state and reconstruction across transfers; formed organization changes later sampling, with actual provision and subsequent revision retained. Original microscopy now supplies checked scale and position-specific capture times, with continued position configuration across two rescue acquisitions; imaging correspondence and culture identity remain distinct. A direct matched-network comparison now establishes an exact conventional realization of the reconstruction mechanism, including shared state-dependent selectors and failed actions. Ren now directs a theoretical focus: reuse formation, reconstruction, updater and goal-revision results, compare their independent premises and added explanation, and selected recovery of a specific connectionist learning result. A predefined field now has a measured 91-frame developmental history; local disappearance after growth is distinguished from boundary censoring, so an observation ending does not alone establish structural loss. A new theoretical connection gives a full-cycle selection threshold and reproductive cost ceiling for inherited reconstruction; direct resemblance can fall, and identical first-generation outputs can conceal opposite growth conditions. The single-step Hebbian direction is now recovered. Finite recurrent sensitivity follows from the developmental law; a sign-compatible tanh regime preserves the direction through finite changes, while feedback and changed selective relations can reverse local gains.
entry_after.scope_zh: 保留16/26、19/41、7/13及6/6定理/审计与反例；本轮新增7项局部定理／11项审计。54段视频/18项技术重复、33/190敏感性、3,808记录/3,600联系及42/72对7/72保持范围；3,424项预测及139分组/485行核验保留。新核对八项生长及两项竞争摘要，不能转作周期概率。初始未形成与后来失效须区分；联合校准、广泛比较与支持更新仍开放。 新保存四份影片，44帧像素对应核验通过；帧数不是重复。基因标签、拍摄时钟及后代联系未齐，未拟合周期概率。 新方向评估已完成，须与生态支架、内生化及演化联结论等强对手比较；优越性未获确立，无新预测或定理。 新核对45项培养物／11个日期组，保留784对769数量歧义与数值容量失败；事件求解只作显式模型适配。 聚焦说明现按用户选定范围完成：20项新 Lean 定理／44项新声明审计／113项闭包审计。有限历史继承及重建不等于入侵稳定性或无限更新；原始干预和强比较已评估，广泛优越性仍未成立。 新核对4,383项目录、388项时间戳、114项首末图像记录及两幅完整像素场；位置时差最大225.89秒，重启间隔337.39秒。处理／终点身份、内部轨迹及六日后代仍未接齐，无新定理。 新增11项 Lean 定理／24项审计及34,768项执行，结论是同等法则下等价，非 Watson 模型复现或经验胜出。直接比较已关合，独立约束的联合经验预测仍开放。 理论整合与作者反审已完成，无新定理；局部前提消解不等于已证比较经济性，伦理延展明示G0及附加承诺。经验校准不作本轮理论完成门槛；广泛优越性仍未证。 新核对91项图像子块及23,855,104个裁剪像素；三种检测阈值与三种移动界限的敏感性保留。四条最长分配轨迹含局部骤失候选及仍可见的边界对象；不拟合坍塌率，不补造后代连接，无新定理。 新增28项 Lean 定理／40项审计，含有限历史界及条件识别；中观产出、路由及传递仍给定，未由细胞事件导出。常规生命周期模型获完整信用，联结论学习恢复及广泛优越性仍开放。 新增29项Lean定理／41项声明审计通过，使用明示的发育与选择规律；保留有限反例及原生法则、初始状态、变异传递等前提。具名方向恢复完成，多格局记忆、干扰和持续修订仍待连接；无新经验预测或广泛原创性声明。
entry_after.scope_en: Preserves 16/26, 19/41, 7/13 and 6/6 theorem/audit results and counterexamples; seven new local-balance theorems / eleven audits pass. The 54 videos/18 technical replicates, 33/190 sensitivity, 3,808 records/3,600 links, 42/72 versus 7/72, 3,424 forecasts and 139-cohort/485-row checks retain their scopes. Eight growth and two competition summaries cannot become cycle probabilities. Initial absence versus later loss, joint calibration, broad comparison and support renewal remain open. Four original movies are preserved and 44 selected-frame correspondences pass; frames are not replicates. Exact genotype attribution, acquisition timing and linked descendants remain incomplete; no cycle probability is fitted. The new direction assessment is complete; ecological scaffolding, endogenization and evolutionary connectionism are strong comparators. Superiority is unestablished, with no new forecast or theorem. New checks cover 45 cultures/11 dated cohorts, preserving a 784-versus-769 count ambiguity and numerical capacity failure; event integration is an explicit model adaptation. The focused account is complete at the selected scope: 20 new Lean theorems / 44 new declaration audits / 113 closure audits. Finite-history inheritance and reconstruction do not establish invasion stability or indefinite renewal; primary interventions and strong comparators are assessed, while broad superiority remains unestablished. New checks cover 4,383 directory entries, 388 timestamps, 114 first/last image records and two complete pixel fields; scene offsets reach 225.89 seconds and the restart gap is 337.39 seconds. Treatment/endpoint identity, interior trajectories and six-day descendants remain unjoined; no new theorem. Eleven new Lean theorems / 24 new audits and 34,768 executed comparisons establish equivalence under matched laws, not Watson-model replication or an empirical win. The direct comparison is closed; independently constrained joint empirical prediction remains open. The theoretical integration and author counterreview are complete, with no new theorem. Internal premise reduction is distinct from demonstrated comparative economy; the ethical extension discloses G0 and further commitments. Empirical calibration is not this task’s theoretical completion gate; broad superiority remains unestablished. New checks cover 91 image subblocks and 23,855,104 crop pixels, preserving detection and movement sensitivity. Four longest assigned tracks include local-loss candidates and a still-visible boundary object; no collapse rate, descendant join or new theorem is asserted. Twenty-eight new Lean theorems / forty audits cover finite-history bounds and conditional identification. Mesoscopic production, routing and transmission remain supplied, not derived from cell events. Conventional life-cycle models retain full credit; connectionist recovery and broad superiority remain open. Twenty-nine new Lean theorems / 41 declaration audits pass under explicit developmental and selection laws. Finite adverse cases and supplied native laws, initial states and mutation/transmission premises remain. The named directional recovery is complete; memory, interference and continued revision across patterns remain to be connected. No new empirical prediction or broad novelty is claimed.
